title: Settled-record notice reads as a credit refusal for a valid registered run
outcome: Settled-record notice reads as a credit refusal for a valid registered run
acceptance: A settled registered committed-input run whose inner command is not a recognized test runner produces host lines from which a reader can tell that its verification record is settled and counts as registered verification evidence, and that only the optional ordinary-check or current-input confirmation is missing. A behavioral test drives such a run through the product path and checks the resulting notice semantics, without pinning text.

GET /api/test-runs/<id> no longer reports an empty run.verificationRecordIds for a run whose detail.verificationRecord is settled with record ids, or the index field is renamed or documented so that it cannot be read as the absence of a record.
